sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Temporal pains with double vision, impaired
sight; brilliant eyes, flushed face.

sections.label: Urinary
sections.text:
Increased secretion; scanty and albu-
minous.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Menorrhagia; uterine haemorrhage;
uterus heavily congested.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Dyspnee. Lungs congested. CEdema
of lungs. Bronchial and cardiac asthma.

sections.label: Heart
sections.text:
Pulse quickened. Heart's action weak,
due to muscular debility; muscular insufficiency. Car-
diac pain, [eratagus.]

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare : Digit, (but is slower than
Strophant. in its action) ; Phos. ac. (weak heart, irreg-
